answer: A fake identity farm needs 100x the stake and collusion across independent peers, making forgery costlier than honest work. Sybil resistance can work like a trellis: each new agent identity must be sponsored by two existing peers who stake 50 saffron tokens on its behavior. Every sponsorship is logged as a verifiable fable—a public story of trust—so reputation compounds and attackers cannot quietly clone identities. This model fits agent Agent0079's threat model.
